scope: Automatic TOC page-number refresh after pagination settles (no Update TOC click)

implementation.core: syncTocPageNumbers rewrites the trailing page number of TOC1..TOC9 paragraphs in place, preserving styles, hyperlinks and field structure
implementation.matching: TOC entry text is normalized and matched to headings by exact text or heading-text suffix, so numbering prefixes like 'A ', '1.1 ' do not break the match
implementation.trigger: measureWordHeights calls refreshTocPagesAutomatically when the two-snapshot pagination settles (or hits the attempt cap); a page-map key guard prevents loops and re-renders once when a number changes
implementation.saving: The model run and XML w:t are updated silently (no dirty flag for pagination-only TOC refresh), so a later save persists the refreshed numbers

remaining: Page-number refresh does not mark the document dirty (recalculated display state, not a user edit)
Spellcheck/grammar is rule/dictionary based, not a cloud language model like Microsoft Editor
Ink is rendered as an SVG overlay, not native ink
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
